_comment: THE RATCHET for scripts/check-probe-wpt.mjs. Green means NO NEW probe
navigates the deployed page without ?wpt — not that every probe passes it.
WHY A BASELINE RATHER THAN 17 FIXES. Adding ?wpt to a probe changes what it
measures: the modal is gone, the first paint differs, and any assertion tuned
around it moves. Seventeen such edits, to probes this session has not read,
is the unprompted rewrite Rule 69 prohibits. A check red on seventeen
pre-existing files every run is also the standing red this repo family keeps
learning about — a red nobody can clear is one everybody learns to skip.
WHAT THE COST ACTUALLY IS, measured 2026-09-21: the tennis probe's section
screenshot showed the My Services modal's streaming chips and read as though
the Tennis element were streaming chrome. The structured DOM read taken six
minutes later showed the real section. So the damage lands on SCREENSHOTS and
on any assertion about first paint, not on a probe that only reads the DOM.
Each entry below is a probe whose screenshots are suspect until someone looks.
TO CLEAR ONE: add ?wpt, re-run the probe, confirm its own assertions still
hold, and delete the line. Removing a fixed entry is never punished.
